verdict.what: a tiered Japanese pagoda-style tower with a stone plinth and a tall central mast
verdict.style: East Asian pagoda / Japanese castle keep, dark timber
verdict.summary: Good stacked pagoda massing with a stone plinth and upturned eave ornaments, but the upper tier reads as open posts from the back, the central mast is stick-thin, and the all-dark-wood palette flattens the roofs into the walls.
